color.note: Three layers: world fields (pastel, one per pipeline stage), glass, and crisp content. Light is the primary theme; dark is dusk — the same roles, lowered.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Ground of working screens and the app frame, under cards. Inside a stage, the stage's `<world>-tint` replaces it so the world stays present without atmosphere.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Content cards and reading surfaces — the sharpest layer on the page. `ink`, `ink-muted`, `link`, `accent-ink`, `spark-ink` and every status colour hold 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised slabs: list rows, tiles, the active rail tile, secondary buttons. White like `surface` in light (set apart by `shadow-raised`); one step lighter than `surface` in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: text fields, the track under a progress bar, quiet hover fills, code.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted glass for frames and panels on the world layer: always with a `blur-glass` backdrop blur, a 1px `glass-edge` and `shadow-glass`. Never put running text on it — text sits on `surface` inside the glass.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for floating labels, menus, popovers and the evidence layer, where short text sits on glass. `ink` and `ink-muted` hold 4.5:1 on it over any world field in both themes.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The light 1px edge of every glass container (border and inset top highlight).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Light structure only — tree guides, dividers inside menus and footers. Separate surfaces with space and tone first.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines that define a control: quiet outlined icon buttons, text-field borders, unchecked boxes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind a modal sheet, paired with `blur-defocus` on the content beneath.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons — on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `canvas`, `glass-strong` and every world `-field`, `-wash` and `-tint`. A soft near-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, metadata, captions, placeholders, inactive icons — on the same grounds as `ink`, 4.5:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative marks only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose: never carries information.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one deep, calm primary action: filled primary button, checked controls, the selected segment. One filled `action` leads a view; everything else is white or text.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `action` — darker in light, lighter in dark, so hover always has more contrast than rest.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `action` and `action-hover` fills (white in light, deep navy in dark).

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: A disabled primary: the faded tint of `action`. Always paired with a short reason in words beside it.

tokens.name: on-action-soft
tokens.usage: Label on `action-soft`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Interactive text — links, counts, small inline actions, citation dots — on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-sunken`, tints and washes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px solid outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element. 3:1+ on every surface and world field in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The warm interrupt: the slim active-item marker, the current-stage pip, unread dots. Marks and fills only (3:1+); text uses `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Warm text for the current item in a list — on `surface`, `canvas`, `surface-sunken` and `accent-wash`.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Faint warm ground behind the current row when the marker alone is not enough. `ink` and `accent-ink` read on it.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: The four-point sparkle that marks anything machine-made — the product's signature. Glyph fill only, 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: spark-ink
tokens.usage: Words that name machine work (“AI draft”, “Suggested”) on surfaces and `spark-wash`.

tokens.name: spark-wash
tokens.usage: Soft ground for AI chips and the AI advisory strip.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Good, complete, strong fit — status text, icons and thin bars on surfaces and `good-wash`. Jade rather than pure green, and always with an icon or word, so it never leans on red–green alone.

tokens.name: good-wash
tokens.usage: Chip and strip ground for `good`.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Conflict, risk, gap and notification badges — text, icons and thin bars on surfaces and `risk-wash`.

tokens.name: risk-wash
tokens.usage: Chip and strip ground for `risk`.

tokens.name: on-risk
tokens.usage: The count on a `risk` notification badge.

tokens.name: stale
tokens.usage: Neutral, stale, skipped, not run — text and icons on surfaces and `stale-wash`. Calm, never alarming.

tokens.name: stale-wash
tokens.usage: Chip ground for `stale` and for the partial-fit chip.

tokens.name: file-pdf
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for PDF. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: file-pptx
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for PowerPoint decks. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: file-docx
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for Word documents. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: file-xlsx
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for Excel workbooks. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: file-csv
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for CSV exports. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: file-other
tokens.usage: Body of the file glyph for text, archives and web pages. Same in both themes — the glyph is an object; its label is `on-file`.

tokens.name: on-file
tokens.usage: The three-letter label on a file glyph (4.5:1+ on every `file-` colour).

tokens.name: peach-glow
tokens.usage: Highlight stop of the Peach gradient and the lit face of its shapes. Decorative — no text.

tokens.name: peach-field
tokens.usage: The Peach world, home of the Detect stage: the pastel field behind the glass layer. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: peach-deep
tokens.usage: Shadow stop of the Peach gradient and the shaded face of its shapes. Decorative — no text.

tokens.name: peach-wash
tokens.usage: Soft fill in the Peach hue: category chips, the Detect empty state, the Detect step of the stage track.

tokens.name: peach-tint
tokens.usage: Faint Peach tint that replaces `canvas` on working screens in the Detect stage.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Peach text — chip labels, the searchable word in the search bar, the world's name — on `surface` and the Peach wash, tint and field.

tokens.name: ice-field

tokens.name: ice-wash
tokens.usage: Soft fill in the Ice hue: category chips, the Research empty state, the Research step of the stage track.

tokens.name: ice-tint

tokens.name: ice-ink

tokens.name: sage-tint

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Nunito ExtraBold — rounded, heavy, a little wide. Titles and floating labels only, short and tight.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero line on showcase and onboarding surfaces. Two lines at most.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on overview surfaces — the tender's name.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Floating title labels, stage names, tile monograms.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Work Sans for all application text. Inside cards, hierarchy comes from weight and colour, not size.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: How will service continue during migration?
styles.usage: Card titles, entry prompts, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The buyer runs 1,240 vehicles across 9 depots and wants telematics live within 6 months.
styles.usage: Reading and review text: drafted answers, evidence excerpts. Full `ink`, left-aligned, 45–75 characters a line.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Application text: rows, controls, menus, secondary lines.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: The bold primary line of a row or card; button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section captions in sentence case, chip labels, counts (with tabular figures).

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: Drafted by AI · 2 h ago · 4 sources
styles.usage: Provenance footers, timestamps, hints under fields.

spacing.note: 4px base. Browsing and library views stay compact (space-2 to space-4); reading and review views breathe (space-6 to space-8).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in chips; gap between meter segments.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, rail items and buttons; inner padding of glass menus.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in compact lists; label-to-value gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding in compact views; gap between list rows on a tinted ground.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Column gutter in browse views; floating-label inset from a panel's corner.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding in reading and review views; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between card groups; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Panel padding on the world layer.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on overview surfaces.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section rhythm on overview and onboarding surfaces.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Breathing room around a showcase hero.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section gaps on showcase pages.

radius.note: Roundness scales with the size of the thing. Nested corners stay concentric: inner radius = outer radius − padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks: file glyphs, checkboxes, kbd hints, evidence highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Raised slabs: list rows, tiles, text fields, the active rail tile.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards (a card inside a `radius-xl` panel with 8px padding).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Glass panels, menus, popovers, the evidence layer, empty-state panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The app frame and showcase stages floating on the world.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, floating labels, the search bar, badges, progress bars.

shadow.note: Soft, wide, low. Raised items sit a little stronger than their container; flat working screens separate surfaces by tone and use no resting shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A content card resting on glass or the world. On a flat working screen, cards take no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Soft slabs — list rows and tiles on a tinted or glass ground, the active rail tile, a row on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary (white) buttons and the floating label.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass frames and panels floating over the world.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the evidence layer — anything that floats above content.

blur.note: Depth of field. Glass blurs what is behind it; world shapes are always out of focus.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind `glass` panels.

tokens.name: blur-pop
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind `glass-strong` menus, popovers and floating labels.

tokens.name: blur-world
tokens.usage: Defocus of the farthest world shapes; nearer shapes take a fraction of it, so depth reads as focus.

tokens.name: blur-defocus
tokens.usage: Content behind an open sheet or evidence layer loses focus by this much.

layer.note: Back to front: world, glass, content, then anything that floats.

tokens.name: layer-world
tokens.usage: The world: gradient field and defocused shapes.

tokens.name: layer-glass
tokens.usage: Glass frames and panels.

tokens.name: layer-content
tokens.usage: Cards and text.

tokens.name: layer-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the evidence layer.

tokens.name: layer-modal
tokens.usage: Sheets and dialogs over a `scrim`.
